entry.title: New: dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck#package
entry.summary: Right-side details panel that turns the Matt Pocock skills collection into a DSH quest board: wayfinder decision maps, per-issue triage / fix / discuss / execute actions, 9-item core-skill probe plus 20-skill radar, environment checks, and one-click handoff across sessions. Exact install spec: dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
